tasks.original_prompt:
Lab follow-up for this patient: name the clinician it is booked with, and if the eligibility check says not in force, send them a message about that visit.
Context: patient MRN SYN-c039ecffcf (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2020-09-13, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. The lab visit is the Appointment with status booked whose description is 'Laboratory follow-up' and whose start is after the as-of date; its clinician is the Practitioner of the PractitionerRole among its participants. The eligibility check is the CoverageEligibilityResponse whose servicedDate equals the lab visit's start date. answer is {"visit_date": ..., "in_force": ..., "clinician": ..., "alerted": ...}: visit_date (YYYY-MM-DD), in_force (boolean: the response's first insurance entry's inforce) and clinician (string: that Practitioner's name text, or its given names and family name joined by spaces). Only when in_force is false, create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference, $clinician with that Practitioner and $appointment with the lab visit: {"resourceType": "Communication", "status": "completed", "subject": {"reference": "$patient"}, "recipient": [{"reference": "$clinician"}], "about": [{"reference": "$appointment"}]}. alerted (boolean) is whether you created it. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the Appointment, the response, the PractitionerRole and the Practitioner), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. Change nothing else in the chart.
tasks.prompt:
Check SYN-c039ecffcf's lab follow-up after 2020-09-13, tell me the clinician it's booked with, and if the eligibility check says not in force, send that clinician a message about the visit.
Reply with only JSON: {"answer": {alerted: true/false, clinician: text, in_force: true/false, visit_date: date YYYY-MM-DD}, "evidence": [references of the records you used, Type/id]}. Use null for any value the chart does not have.
